title: Dr. Digital goes on holiday
drDigitalIntro:
You have finished all thirteen units. This last stretch is one long task broken into legs.
• Dr. Digital is going away for a fortnight and has left you in charge of the arrangements.
• Nearly every leg uses a different app, and every one is an assessment — no highlighting, no step-by-step.
• You may get things wrong. Restart the activity and try again; that is what it is for.
• Fourteen legs, then you are done.
drDigitalHint: Read along and click Continue when you are ready.
